//: Run the functions in Mumbai, beside the database.
Vercel defaults to iad1 (Washington DC). The Supabase project is in
ap-south-1 (Mumbai), so every query on that default crossed the
Atlantic and the Indian Ocean and back — roughly 220-260ms per round
trip. Pages here are force-dynamic and issue several queries each, so
that distance was paid over and over on a single page load, before the
connection handshake (TCP + TLS + Postgres auth = four more round
bom1 is Vercel's Mumbai region. Same city as the database, so the
round trip falls to single-digit milliseconds and the whole cost
largely disappears rather than being optimised around.
If the Supabase project is ever moved, this must move with it. The two
belong in the same region; which region matters far less than that.
